plan.title: No way to clear a 'troubled' agent after the Cut: errors say 'pan untroubled' but the command no longer exists
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Cut (PAN-3917, commit a1def1f8959) deleted `pan untroubled` believing there was no stored troubled flag, but applyAgentFailure still sets `troubled` after three failures in ten minutes and it still blocks pan start, pan resume, dashboard Start and MERGE. Four operator messages (start.ts:790, agent-state.ts:786/794, routes/agents/shared.ts:572, parked/resolver.ts:186) name the dead verb, and `pan start --force` clears only the paused gate, so operators must hand-edit ~/.overdeck/agents/<agent>/state.json.
narratives.Proposal: Restore `pan untroubled <id>` as a clear-only verb over clearAgentTroubled that records an `untroubled` operator intervention; make `pan start <id> --force` also clear the troubled gate (parity with dashboard clearGates) and record the intervention; reword the start refusal to name both doors; extend src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts so every troubled/paused gate message is checked against the CLI registry; restore the pan-untroubled skill and correct THE-CUT, PIPELINE-GATES, ISSUE-VIEW, SKILLS-CONVENTION and the pan-start skill.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A troubled-gate recovery dialog in the dashboard frontend (StartAgentCta, ResumableSessionDialog, resumeRecovery.ts)
- Changing when the troubled gate is set (threshold, window, backoff)
- Removing the troubled flag or the failure tracking fields
- Making --fresh alone clear the troubled gate
- Recording an unpause intervention for the pause clear pan start --force already performs
- Re-adding a dashboard POST /api/agents/:id/untroubled route
- Rewording the agent-state.ts, shared.ts and parked/resolver.ts messages (they become correct once the verb exists)
- Un-skipping or regenerating tests/fixtures/pan-help.txt
- pan untroubled resuming or spawning the agent

autoDecisions.summary: Provide both clearing doors: restored `pan untroubled <id>` and `pan start <id> --force` clearing the troubled gate.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists both; the dashboard's clearGates already clears paused and troubled together, and --force is the CLI's advertised gate override, so the CLI now matches. The verb gives a clear-without-spawn door the MERGE and parked-row messages need.

autoDecisions.summary: `pan untroubled` is clear-only: it never resumes or spawns.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches its deleted implementation and the help text still in tests/fixtures/pan-help.txt ('Clear an agent troubled gate without spawning it'); a repeatedly crashing agent should restart only when the operator chooses.

autoDecisions.summary: `--fresh` alone does not clear the troubled gate; only `--force` (alone or with --fresh) does.
autoDecisions.rationale: --fresh replaces a session and is not a gate override; keeping gate overrides on one flag keeps the semantics of each flag single-purpose.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the agent-state.ts, shared.ts and resolver.ts message text unchanged; reword only the start.ts refusal.
autoDecisions.rationale: Once the verb is registered those messages are correct; the start refusal is the one place both doors apply.

autoDecisions.summary: Guard recurrence by extending src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts rather than adding a new mechanism.
autoDecisions.rationale: That test already checks agent-facing text against COMPOSER_COMMAND_MANIFEST, which is drift-gated against the real CLI registry.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard frontend troubled recovery dialog is out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: The backend already supports clearGates; the UI change is a separate vertical slice and the issue asks for a CLI door plus correct messages.

items.title: Restore the pan untroubled <id> clear-only verb

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4211.md WI-1. Create src/cli/commands/untroubled.ts mirroring src/cli/commands/unpause.ts target resolution (resolveAgentTarget, getAgentState), clear through Effect.runPromise(clearAgentTroubled(agentId)), record appendOperatorInterventionEvent({ issueId, kind: 'untroubled', source: 'pan untroubled' }) only when the state was troubled or had consecutiveFailures > 0, print 'Cleared troubled state for agent: <agentId>' then 'Run pan start <issueId> to spawn it.', or 'Agent <agentId> is already untroubled.' when clear. Never spawn or resume. Catch error: unknown (no any). Register 'untroubled <id>' in src/cli/index.ts right after the unpause block with description 'Clear an agent troubled gate without spawning it'. Regenerate the composer manifest (npm run build:cli && npm run generate:slash-commands) and commit it. Restore sync-sources/skills/pan-untroubled/SKILL.md from the pan-unpause template (no Deacon auto-resume claim) and add pan-untroubled to tests/fixtures/synced-skills.txt after pan-unpause. Add src/cli/commands/__tests__/untroubled.test.ts with the four cases in WI-1 step 6.

Make pan start --force clear the troubled gate

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. In src/cli/commands/start.ts add shouldClearTroubledBeforeSpawn = existingAgentState?.troubled === true && options.force === true; skip the troubled refusal when --force is set; reword the refusal's last line to 'Investigate the crash cause, then run pan untroubled <id> to clear the gate, or pan start <id> --force to clear it and start now.'; add a local clearTroubledForForce(agentId, issueId) that runs Effect.runPromise(clearAgentTroubled(agentId)) then appendOperatorInterventionEvent({ issueId, kind: 'untroubled', source: 'pan start --force' }); call it next to both existing pause clears (local spawn near line 1189 and inside handleRemoteWorkspace near line 419 via a new clearTroubledBeforeSpawn parameter); pass allowTroubledForce: shouldClearTroubledBeforeSpawn to assertCanStartFresh. In src/lib/work-agent-lifecycle.ts add allowTroubledForce to StartFreshOptions and widen the paused-force override to a gate-force override covering troubled. Change the --force description in src/cli/index.ts to 'Clear paused, troubled, and pending-operator-decision gates and start anyway' and regenerate the manifest. --fresh without --force must still refuse a troubled agent. start.ts is at its 1265-line allowlist cap: if it grows, add '<lines> src/cli/commands/start.ts # PAN-4211' to scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt in the same commit.

metadata.sizeJustification: 17 files total; the 11-subsystem count comes from the tests, generated composer manifest, skill, fixture and docs that accompany two small CLI changes (one restored verb, one --force branch). Every item is one vertical slice of the same regression fix; splitting into sibling issues would ship the verb without its guard test or docs and leave THE-CUT.md contradicting the code.
